operators.name: custom_mean

returns.shape: same as input except dim replaced by 1 if keepdim=True, otherwise removed

semantics: Computes arithmetic mean along dimension dim.
Corresponds to torch.mean(input, dim=self.mean_dim, keepdim=True) with self.mean_dim=2.
Broadcasts reduction across batch and channels; result shape [16,3,1,2048].
Uses float32 accumulation matching PyTorch mean behavior for CUDA float32 input.
Supports arbitrary strides; must handle non-contiguous tensors correctly.

operators.name: custom_gt
semantics: Computes element-wise input > other with broadcasting.
Corresponds to torch.gt(x, mean_tensor) after mean computation.
Input shape [16,3,2048,2048], other shape [16,3,1,2048]; other broadcast along height dimension.
Result bool tensor same shape as input, same strides.
Order of comparison is elementwise; no reduction.
Step 1: compute mean along dim=2 with keepdim=True producing shape [16,3,1,2048] float32.
Step 2: element-wise greater-than comparison with broadcasting along dim=2 producing bool tensor shape [16,3,2048,2048].
The result tensor is assigned back to x so it has the same shape and dtype as the comparison output.
Final output is bool tensor on cuda with stride [12582912, 4194304, 2048, 1].
Returns the bool tensor computed in step_001.
No further computation; output shape/dtype/device/strides unchanged.
